name: clearspring-bible3d
description: Builds the 3D Bible world into static/vendor/bible3d/. Run: npm install, then npm run build.

scripts.build: cd ../.. && rm -rf static/vendor/bible3d && npx --prefix tools/bible3d esbuild bible3d=tools/bible3d/bible3d.src.js --bundle --minify --format=esm --splitting --chunk-names=[name]-[hash] --outdir=static/vendor/bible3d --log-level=warning
